summary: Rejected after independently replaying and reviewing all 77 sealed operations against audit 3e6bf3d69d and the pinned source. The candidate correctly removes borrowed Zhuangzong reign windows, identifies the separate Tianyou 10 / AD 913 Wei-Bo episode, preserves conservative Tianyou and retrospective holds, and removes unsupported family, honor, and composite endpoints. It also correctly repairs the other early/late-era phase claims. But claim-137, the companion attestation for the s0054 Early Kaiyun Yangcheng campaign, is accidentally rewritten as early Tiancheng AD 926–927. That is a six-century-era mix-up in the candidate itself: s0054 says 開運初, and the related office and participation repairs correctly use AD 944–945. The defective companion claim means the sealed candidate cannot be curated.

reviewedChanges.reason: Claim-137 retains sourceDate 開運初 but replaces its prior AD 944 point with AD 926–927 and calls it early Tiancheng. 開運 is Later Jin Kaiyun, whose first two years are AD 944–945; the candidate's own claim-118 and claim-119 correctly use that interval. Replace claim-137 with the same AD 944–945 phase interval, revise its unresolved reason to Early Kaiyun, and keep the event description and evidence unchanged.
